subject: Privacy Annex & execution options for Atlas PoC
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.b@atlasretail.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@atlasretail.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Privacy Annex & execution options for Atlas PoC

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning — Atlas is excited to move the PoC forward. Before we kick off, our legal and security teams asked for the following so we can complete procurement:

- A copy of Redwood's proposed privacy annex/DPA for our PoC (we have a short redline of our own attached).
- Confirmation on subprocessors (list + whether any are outside the EU for EU-resident data).
- Preferred e-sign path: does Redwood use DocuSign or AdobeSign? We need a signed agreement (DocuSign preferred).
- A short note on data residency and retention for logs/KV cache — we need these points in writing for our audit.

I've attached our initial redline for your review. Can you share Redwood's template and advise on the fastest execution path? We're hoping to complete legal review and sign within 5 business days to stay on track for the August PoC start.

Appreciate it —
Evan

[Attachment: Atlas_DPA_Initial_Redline.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.b@atlasretail.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy Annex & execution options for Atlas PoC

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear ask and for sending your redline. Looping in Dev (engineering security) and Marissa (privacy/legal ops) so we can respond with the right level of detail.

Quick summary / attachments:
- Attached: Redwood_Privacy_Annex_v1.docx — this is our standard privacy annex that sits alongside the Master Services Agreement. It includes subprocessors and transfer mechanisms.
- Execution: Redwood prefers DocuSign for RPOs, but we can execute through AdobeSign if you require. Either way we can produce an audit trail and signed PDF.
- Subprocessors: the annex includes a list of our primary subprocessors (hosting, metrics, monitoring). We will provide a full subprocessor register as part of onboarding; none of our listed subprocessors process EU customer content in the Atlas PoC scope other than our cloud provider's EU region (we can pin region-specific deployments).
- Transfers/controls: for EU transfers we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) + appropriate technical controls; if you need data to remain in-region we can discuss a dedicated deployment in eu-west-1 for the PoC.
- Retention: request/response logs are retained for 30 days by default; KV cache is ephemeral for the PoC unless you request longer retention — we can document retention in SOW.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa to review Atlas redline and call out any absolute blockers.
2) If redline changes are minor, we can prepare a DocuSign envelope and request countersignature (target 48 hours).
3) If larger redlines appear, schedule a 30-min legal alignment call (please propose times).

FYI attaching the annex and the PoC SOW draft we discussed.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy Annex & execution options for Atlas PoC

Aisha — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the annex. A few clarifications from our side before we escalate to legal:

- Atlas' redline asks for a 90-day log retention minimum for debugging and fraud analysis. Is Redwood open to 90 days for request/response logs as a PoC exception?
- Who is the signatory on Redwood's side for the annex (name & title) so our procurement team can prepare the DocuSign envelope?
- Can you also share a SOC 2 Type II report (or an SOC letter) for our security intake?

We are happy to proceed with DocuSign; Priya will coordinate the procurement steps and will include our legal counsel if we need to present the redline.

Thanks — Evan

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy Annex & execution options for Atlas PoC (internal)

Aisha / Marissa — internal next steps and negotiation plan based on Evan's asks:

- Logs/retention: engineering can support a 90-day retention window for request/response logs as a PoC opt-in, provided Atlas accepts the additional cost and we scope retention in the SOW. KV cache remains ephemeral; we can document retention and masking rules.
- Signatory: Marissa — who is the appropriate signee on the annex? If legal prefers, we can have the VP of Sales sign or use Director-level authorization for PoC-sized deals.
- SOC 2: we have the latest SOC 2 Type II report; will provide an SSAE redacted copy to Atlas under NDA.
- Subprocessors: provide the full register; confirm there are no third-country subprocessors beyond the cloud provider EU region we mentioned.

Recommendation: accept Atlas' 90-day ask for the PoC as a one-time deviation, prepare a DocuSign envelope with Redwood_Privacy_Annex_v1.docx, and offer Atlas the option to request a dedicated eu deployment if they later expand.

I'll draft a short negotiation memo for Marissa to use with legal. If you agree, I'll block 30 minutes tomorrow for a legal hand-off call and prep the DocuSign draft.

- Dev

[Attachment: SOW_Atlas_PoC.pdf (application/pdf)]
